sample_unit: questions (one response per model per query)

links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses on fertility preservation for breast cancer patients
links.effect: All LLM responses were too complex for the general public and failed to meet the recommended year 6 to 8 reading comprehension standards; most outputs were at secondary school or legal document reading level.
links.quote: The responses generated by all LLMs are too complex for the general public and fail to meet the recommended reading comprehension standards for years 6 to 8; the writing standards of most outputs are equivalent to those of secondary school education, or the reading level required for legal documents.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the reliability (DISCERN, EQIP, GQS, JAMA) and readability (FRES, FKGL, etc.) of four generative LLMs on queries regarding fertility preservation in breast cancer, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
